scope: UnitBasisPoints and the closely coupled SignedUnitBasisPoints, their constructors, operations, Serde and separately qualified native SATS admission, and selected producers and aggregates needed to assess the bounded fraction contract.
coverage_qualification: All thirteen lenses have bounded initial source reports. A later locked offline cargo-tree query resolves the world-schema spacetimedb feature for the selected module package. A distinct local feature-enabled macro expansion at 5f84 succeeded and was source-inspected; neither is a runtime decode, a deployed feature graph or proof of supported input. lenses.name: unfinished producers
lenses.trace: Selected mitigation storage retains raw u16; selected writers, clamp and disease guard are traced. Carrying a checked owner is a separate migration question; other writers and policy remain open.

lenses.name: existing owners
lenses.trace: Compare unit leaves, role wrappers, floating unit interval and unbounded ratio; representation or shared scale alone does not establish interchangeable semantics.

lenses.name: admission
lenses.trace: Checked constructors coexist with transparent derived Serde and a separate feature-gated native derive. Source traces predict bypass; actual supported ingress and macro expansion remain open.

lenses.name: invariant operations
lenses.trace: Valid complement and widened scaling are bounded; invalid decoded unsigned input violates complement's premise. Selected disease and audio paths have guards.

lenses.name: aggregates
lenses.trace: LandUseProfile independently enforces four fractions summing to one whole through checked Serde; posterior tie and observation condition/confidence policies are separately unresolved.

lenses.name: wrong or duplicate owners
lenses.trace: Signed and unsigned unit owners and role wrappers have distinct semantics. Existing floating and unbounded ratio owners are not equivalent substitutes.

lenses.name: redundant authority
lenses.trace: Common 10000 scale and independent decode routes; observation condition/confidence may be historical snapshots. No automatic consolidation or impact established.

lenses.name: behavior preservation
lenses.trace: Preserve numeric Serde wire shape, valid endpoints, ordering, defaults, saturation and rounding; rejection of formerly accepted out-of-range input is deliberate.

lenses.name: enum and state shape
lenses.trace: Vegetation posterior, categorical and inferred forms remain distinct; exact sum or nonzero policy not established.

lenses.name: derivability
lenses.trace: Transparent Serde bypasses the checked constructor; pinned derive source rejects transparent plus container try_from/into. Field-level checked decode or separately validated alternatives remain candidates. SATS derive is independent.

lenses.name: type granularity
lenses.trace: Unsigned/signed and semantic role distinctions remain meaningful; no concrete cross-role misuse established.

lenses.name: raw strings
lenses.trace: No raw domain-string field in the owners. Framework and predicted SATS field names are interface metadata; surrounding strings remain incomplete.

lenses.name: raw primitives
lenses.trace: Private u16/i16 represent intentional quantized boundaries; checked owner invariants and aggregate constraints remain distinct.

findings.evidence: Locked Serde source and the later local feature-enabled expansion show direct primitive-field construction for both owners, while their new constructors reject values outside the unit bounds. Native generated product visitors and validate paths similarly operate on raw fields. No invalid payload, runtime decode, panic or supported ingress was observed.
findings.discovery: bounded; actual input, all consumers, target/deployment feature graphs, native usage, policy and global aliases remain open
findings.connected_repair_direction: Independently reviewed design favors manual native owner implementations using checked named-product wire visitors, preserving the original owner TypeId, product and field names, numeric Serde forms, and default native validation routing. A checked primitive leaf remains an alternative with representation and trait risks. Neither is implemented or verified; compare actual generated schema and valid native encoding before claiming preservation.
findings.acceptance: For both owners and every supported Serde/native decode or validation entry point, valid endpoints preserve numeric Serde shape and the existing named native product, and out-of-range primitive values are rejected before entering the owner. Preserve explicit saturation and LandUseProfile’s independent sum rule. Apply repository test policy and disclose any untested route.

open_questions.detail: The separately generated local 5f84 feature-enabled expansion shows named basis_points products and native sequence/named visitors that construct raw primitive fields; validate checks primitive/product shape. Cargo-tree resolves the feature for the selected module package. Bounded search found no current exact owner in a table or reducer, while public feature-enabled BSATN decoding is a separate possible admission. Actual malformed input, deployment configuration and subsequent validation remain open; q2332/ledger 1062 are qualified relationships.
LandUseProfile has an independent exact-sum constructor/Serde invariant; native validation remains separately unproved.
All-zero or tied vegetation scores select the first maximum; supported data and intended tie/total policy remain open.
Selected generated observations derive confidence from conditions, but public records allow other bounded combinations; snapshot semantics, actual decode and policy remain open.
Raw authority mitigation has selected guards and clamping; other writers, supported persisted input, schema and migration policy remain open.

SettlementImport contains distinct raw-backed LandUseFraction, SoilBasisPoints and SuitabilityBasisPoints native owners. Selected guards reconstruct land-use sum but appear to retain soil confidence; authorized malformed native import and all remaining guards are unproved. Separate first operations and historical aliases remain open.

Pinned Serde derive rejects transparent combined with container try_from/into. A checked field decoder, manual Deserialize, or replacing transparent with equivalent conversion derive require separate validation. Serde changes alone do not fix native SATS.
